idea-plugin.name: Blamely
idea-plugin.description:
Blamely attributes every line of code to AI or human — across inline completions, chat apply, and agent runs. The breakdown appears in the status bar as you work, survives branch switches, and attaches permanently to each commit via git notes.

All data stays on your machine. No account, no telemetry, no network access.

How it works

  1. Record. When an AI tool edits a file, its hook calls blamely record <tool>.
  2. Watch. The daemon also tails Cursor logs, Copilot transcripts, and filesystem activity.
  3. Attribute. On every commit, the global post-commit hook diffs the commit against stored edits and writes per-line attribution.
  4. Report. The IDE plugin reads those notes back into the status bar, tool window, and gutter.

After each commit

A clear AI vs Human bar prints in your terminal immediately after git commit:

AI 72% (18)  [████████████████████████████░░░░░░░░░░░░]  Human 28% (7)
  claude  12 lines  (claude-opus-4-6) — 4200 in / 890 out tok
  cursor   6 lines  (composer-1)      — 1100 in / 340 out tok

Status bar

The status bar widget shows live AI / Human metrics for the active file:

AI: 751 © 24 = 98%  |  Human: 12 © 3 = 2%  |  claude-opus-4-6

© = characters, = = lines. Click to open the full panel.

Changes tool window

The Blamely → Changes tab shows per-file AI / Human breakdown for all uncommitted work on the current branch, with a visual progress bar per file and a session summary at the bottom.

History tool window

The Blamely → History tab shows AI vs Human share across past commits — total lines, per-model breakdown, commit table with timing, and a segmented bar. Example:

482 AI lines · 40.2%  |  716 Human · 59.8%
18 commits · 44 files · Coding: 32m 17s · AI wait: 50s

#1  claude-opus-4-6  135 lines · 28.0% · 1 commit
#2  cursor-composer   82 lines · 17.0% · 3 commits

Example report.yml (attached to each commit)

scope: "this_commit"
generated_at: "2026-03-05T00:43:50Z"
branch: "main"
commit_hash: "3317ed295e"
commit_message: "[AI-assisted] feat: update analysis"

ai_sources:
  - claude
  - cursor

files:
  - path: "src/utils/parser.ts"
    source: "claude"
    model: "claude-opus-4-6"
    ai_lines_added: 22
    human_lines_added: 65
    percentage: "40.0%"

Requirements — Install the CLI first

macOS

curl -sSL https://blamely.ai/blamely-mac-install.sh | bash

Linux

curl -sSL https://blamely.ai/blamely-linux-install.sh | bash

Windows (PowerShell)

powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "irm https://blamely.ai/blamely-windows-install.bat | iex"

Installers are idempotent — safe to re-run after adding a new AI tool. Verify:

blamely status    # daemon health + detected tools
blamely doctor    # full self-check

Full guide: blamely.ai

Features

  • Line-level blame — Gutter icons + tooltips (AI vs human per line)
  • Status bar widget — Live AI / Human chars, lines, percentage, active model
  • Changes tool window — Per-file breakdown for uncommitted work on current branch
  • History tool window — Per-model stats, commit table, timing across past commits
  • Git notes — report.yml on every commit via refs/notes/blamely
  • Pre-commit / pre-push hooks — Survive plugin upgrades via stable runner scripts
  • Branch-scoped sessions — State under .git/blamely/<branch>/
  • Actions — Generate Report, Show Blame, Install/Restore Hook, Show Commit Report, Push AI Notes
  • VS Code compatible — Same .git/blamely layout; both IDEs share attribution data

action.description: Refresh gutter attribution for active editor
